svg.aria-label: Insert into a list, in memory. Insert one element at a random index of the list (seeded). Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: syncom (the pure build: only its text is typed through openText()); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (no list that merges by position); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
